items.t: Bank of America Just Changed Its Fed Call to Three Straight Hikes. The Hit to a Widow’s $400,000 Bond Fund Already Happened, and Her Cash Is About to Get a Raise
items.sum: Bank of America now expects the Fed to raise rates in December, January and March, to a peak of 4.50% to 4.75%. Here is what that does to a 72-year-old widow's $700,000 of safe money: a $1,500 raise on her money market fund, a CD renewal worth more than any hike, a bond fund that already took its $19,363 hit, and an annuity rate the Fed does not set.

items.t: Can Bank of America (BAC) Still Be Undervalued Here?
